case.summary: This case was triggered by customer C08106 reporting an unauthorized online purchase of $128.33 on transaction 3583227 using card C08106-K1 on 2016-12-29. The graph and case-memory data highlighted that the card has three earlier confirmed fraud cases between July and September 2016, and the current transaction occurred on a new device profile. The final verdict is fraud with a final fraud probability of 0.73, supported by the cardholder's denial and historical precedent. The recommended actions include blocking the card (routed L1, pending approval) and creating a case to record the investigation in the graph (auto).

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Assumed: the cardholder confirms they still hold the card and did not make or authorise transaction 3583227 ($128.33). Basis: the cardholder's own report, although the graph evidence alone points to normal use (graph-only probability 0.01).

initial.reason: Policy 3a: probability >= 0.30, evidence requested or customer dispute

final.reason: R2: cardholder denies the activity; exposure $128.33 <= $2,500 -> L1
R2: record the investigation and write it to the graph

next_best_actions.what_changed: The cardholder's (assumed) denial moved the fraud probability from 0.25 to 0.73, so R2 now applies: added BLOCK_CARD; dropped VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER, MONITOR_CARD.

sar.reason: No report (policy 3a): fraud is confirmed but exposure $128.33 is under $1,000, no shared device/region/ring link and the pattern is documented. Case only.
